_doc: The One House run (scripts/town/one_house.gd, the scenario `OneHouse`): one survivor in one house of a big town, the same rules as the colony with the community modules switched on as people arrive. min_per_sec: game minutes per real second (2.0: a game hour is 30 s). difficulty: the run's difficulty (1 Standard). total_days: the run's nominal length for the clock and the briefing (the run really ends at the first held night, and `total_days()` is never less than the day after it). ideas_from_day: when the community starts to propose things. start: the hour of the first morning (7: the run begins on the road at the forest edge, scripts/town/arrival.gd) and the stores a run begins with (every stock named; the colony's full ones are not used). arrival: mark_r is how near (tiles) the avatar must be to a candidate house for its marker and for the lesson 'find a house'; lone_dead is how far from the entry (tiles, from and to) the scenario puts its one dead one on the road to the first house; quiet_r is how far round the entry the street's dead are taken away when the generator has not kept it clear itself. modules_from_crew: for each community module the number of living people (the avatar counted) from which it is on (99: never in this run). attack: from_rescue is how many rescued survivors make the dead come every night; cutoff_hour is the hour of day after which a fourth rescue puts the first attack on the next night instead of tonight (0: always the next night, a whole day to fortify: the pace of the demo). night: the size of the attack nights as a share of the colony's ordinary night (`first` is the first attack night, each one after is `growth` more); `surges` [{at: hours after the dusk begins, share: of the night's dead}] are the groups the dead are let in in, with lulls between (scripts/town/town_rules.gd), `surge_gap` the seconds between the groups of a surge, `tight` how alike the pace of a surge's dead is (0 the colony's wide spread, 1 all alike: they arrive together). big_night: the first attack night's theme (as demo.json: theme, name, blurb, factor, runners, brutes, min_brutes, brute_at, plated; `headings` how many sides the dead come from, 1 or 2; main_share; cap). held_rule: what a night needs to count as held, judged ONCE at the first moment of the day after it (a night that is not held goes on to the next): the avatar or whoever leads is alive, no dead are in the house, a section of the base still stands, and (`base_whole`) none of the base's sections (fence, gate, barred doors) is down: the dawn hour is the last chance to mend a breach. guide: the lessons, in order; each is done when its cond is true (walked: tiles the avatar has walked; kills: the dead put down; near_candidate: within n tiles of a house that can be claimed; rooms_seen: rooms of the house in hand opened, or a house that is no candidate entered; house_clear; searched: containers searched; claimed; asked: a verb picked on someone on the command wheel) and none blocks anything. The first seven are the lone survivor's, shown until the first voice is on the radio; a lesson marked crew (the eighth, how to ask the crew) is shown from then until the dead come. objective, words and end: what the player reads (%d and %s are filled in by the module). The enemy is 'the dead'.

big_night.name: The first night
big_night.blurb: They have heard the radio. Walkers and runners from two streets, and two plated brutes: only their heads are soft.

guide.title: Walk
guide.text: W A S D to walk. The town is up the road. It is quiet, which is not the same as empty.

guide.title: Aim and shoot
guide.text: Hold the right mouse button to aim, click to fire. One of the dead is standing on the road ahead. A shot carries, so make it count.
guide.goal: Put one of the dead down

guide.title: Find a house
guide.text: Houses ahead. Get close and each one tells you what it is. A big house takes longer to clear and holds more. A small one is quick, and cramped.

guide.title: Doors
guide.text: Rooms you have not seen stay dark. Walk through a door, or stand at one and press E to look in.

guide.title: Clear it
guide.text: Every room has to be empty of the dead. They do not always stay where they were.

guide.title: Search
guide.text: Stand at a shelf or a cabinet and press E. Hold still while you look.

guide.title: Claim it
guide.text: Stand just inside the front door and press E. The house is yours: a bed, a stash, a radio.

guide.title: Ask, do not order
guide.text: Click a person, or their picture at the top. A ring of orders opens round them. Pick one. They may say no, and they will say why.

dusk.title: Dusk
dusk.text: The bell has rung. After dark the streets are thick with the dead. Be indoors. At your own bed, E sleeps until dawn.

stores.title: Running low
stores.text: Food or water is running low. The houses have more: search their cupboards and fridges (E).

ammo.title: Rounds
ammo.text: Rounds are running short. Drawers and cabinets hold more. Every shot is heard: make each one count.

wound.title: A wound
wound.text: A bite bleeds until it is bandaged, and there is nobody else to do it. Press E where you stand: it takes a medicine. Until then you lose health by the hour.

fever.title: A fever
fever.text: The bite took: you have a fever, and in a day it will turn you. Press E where you stand to treat it. It takes two medicine, and it may not work the first time.

runner.title: A runner
runner.text: A runner. Fast and frail: you cannot outrun it, so shoot it.

brute.title: A brute
brute.text: A brute. Slow, huge and hard to put down. Keep your distance and keep firing.

arrive.sub: Houses ahead: pick one to claim

clear.sub_unknown: Open the doors. Mind what is behind them

claim.sub: Stand just inside the front door and press E
claim.sub_search: Search the shelves (E), then claim it at the front door

rescue.sub: Clear a house, then talk to who is hiding in it
rescue.sub_cramped: The yard is awkward: the fence will fit what it can. Find survivors

fortify.sub: Open the Build page (N) and order the front fence
fortify.sub_going: The builders are on it. Be home before dusk
fortify.sub_done: Everything is built. Wait for dusk, and keep your gun loaded

hold.sub: Until dawn. Shoot, and mend what breaks

words.tagline: One house. One survivor. A town full of the dead.
words.new_game: You arrive alone at the edge of a dead town. Choose a house, clear it, claim it, find people. When four voices are on the radio, the dead come every night.

best: A roomy home: a bed, a stash, a radio. Keep it clear
ok: A bed, a stash, a radio. Keep it clear
poor: It is small, but it is yours
A bed, a stash, a radio. Keep it clear

words.new_game_caption: How hard the nights are, and the seed
fourth_tomorrow: The dead will come tomorrow night
news_fourth: The dead can hear it too. They will come at dusk, and every dusk after
victory: Dawn, and the house is still standing
defeat: Nobody is left to hold it

wall: A wall is down at dawn. Mend it: the dead come back at dusk
house: The dead are in the house
base: Nothing of the wall is left standing

end.title: The night is held
end.line: Four voices, a fence and a roof. The dead will be back at dusk, and so will you.
end.full: The full game has more of the town to clear, more people to find and worse nights.
